general_concepts.definition: A process of **continuous exchange** between the subject individual and the environment , seen as a **dialogical movement** from the present, given reality towards the person's goals and intentions[cite: 1376].
general_concepts.expression: An expression of the (mostly unconscious) human intention to **be-come**, to come into existence[cite: 1377].
general_concepts.new_addition: Motivation is fundamentally related to the **structure of existence** (4FMs), which in turn shapes the substance of the motivation[cite: 1379].
general_concepts.integrative_view: Motivation arises from a **correspondence between an external stimulus and subjective, inner potential**[cite: 825]. It also arises from the **continuous internal needs of the individual**[cite: 826].

general_concepts.focus: An **interpersonal paradigm** (a complement and counterweight to the individualistic paradigm of freedom and personal will)[cite: 1420].
general_concepts.core_activity: The most original activity of personhood: Our being essentially **dialogical**, prone to and directed towards **exchange with others**[cite: 798].

general_concepts.definition: Human existence is based on these four fundamental realities, which are the **foundation of a fulfilled life**[cite: 1374, 1375].
general_concepts.function: They form a **matrix for the psychopathological understanding** of psychological disorders [cite: 811] and represent the **structural model for modern Existential Analytical Psychotherapy**[cite: 812].
general_concepts.process: The motivational process includes a coming to terms with the **reality of one's existence** ('being in the world'), with the **reality of one's life**, and finally with an awareness of **one's identity**[cite: 809]. This enables openness to **relationships and wider contexts** from which **personal meanings are discovered**[cite: 810].

general_concepts.definition: The spiritual (i.e., **noetic**) power embedded in personhood functions as a **tool for processing information in motivation**[cite: 800].
general_concepts.role: This power is operative in all motivation [cite: 807] and plays the decisive role in the motivational process[cite: 801].

critique_of_frankl.frankl_definition: Humans are primarily and most profoundly motivated by their personal **'will to meaning'** [cite: 831], which is a **spiritual striving** for a deeper understanding of what one experiences or does[cite: 832].
critique_of_frankl.frankl_cornerstones: Frankl's spiritual dimension is marked by three basic human potentials: **'psychological' spirituality, freedom, and responsibility**[cite: 835].
critique_of_frankl.längle_critique: In the motivational angle of his theory, Frankl may have adopted some **individualistic thinking** by tracing back and reducing the concept of existential motivation to the concept of **will**[cite: 848, 1420].
critique_of_frankl.context: Frankl chose the term **'will'** to meaning to formulate a counterweight to Nietzsche's **'will to power'**[cite: 850, 1422].

motivational_process_pea.core_action: Motivation means **involvement of the person** [cite: 1375], initiating the personal processes by **provocation in some kind of vis-à-vis**[cite: 1411].
motivational_process_pea.starting_point: Being provoked means **being called**. The necessary provocation comes through everything which **confronts us, challenges us, engages us**[cite: 1411].

steps.description: **Recognizing something in its worth or value, in as far as it speaks to...**.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to be; to endure/uphold. (FM of World/Reality)
primary_domains.task_as_cornerstone: First come to terms with his or her **being in the world**[cite: 809, 1382].

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to feel value/life. (FM of Life/Value)
primary_domains.existential_question: I am alive - do I like this fact? Is it good to be there? [cite: 618]
primary_domains.task_as_cornerstone: Then with **his or her own life**[cite: 809, 1382].

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to be oneself; to be just. (FM of Self/Justice)
primary_domains.existential_question: I am myself - may I be like this? [cite: 671]
primary_domains.task_as_cornerstone: And finally with **his or her identity**[cite: 809, 1382].

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to do good; to be creative/meaning. (FM of Meaning/Future)
primary_domains.existential_question: I am there - for what is it good? [cite: 729]
primary_domains.task_as_cornerstone: Subsequent to these tasks, the person is open for and prone to **enter into relationships with a greater context (horizon), from which personal meaning is derived**[cite: 810, 1383].
